headerDisplay: HomeKit Secure Video for a Ring doorbell. **Version 0.1 adds nothing to HomeKit yet**: it signs in to Ring, logs the doorbell's events and, with **Stream probe** on, tests whether its video can be recorded without re-encoding. Run it on its own child bridge, next to homebridge-ring.

refreshToken.title: Ring refresh token
refreshToken.description: A token made for this plugin, not the one homebridge-ring uses (two apps sharing one token sign each other out). On the Pi: cd ~ && npx -y -p ring-client-api@14.3.0 ring-auth-cli. The plugin saves the newer tokens Ring issues, so this one is only used once.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: The doorbell's name in the Ring app, or its id (both are in the log at start). Leave empty if the account has one doorbell.

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg path
ffmpegPath.description: The ffmpeg to use. Leave empty for the one ring-client-api brings (ffmpeg-for-homebridge).

probe.title: Stream probe
probe.description: Once, 15 s after Homebridge starts: a live call from the doorbell (like Live View in the Ring app, with its battery use), measured and saved as an MP4 in the plugin's folder. The log says whether HomeKit Secure Video can record its video as it is. Turn it off afterwards.

debug.title: ring-client-api debug log
debug.description: The library's own detailed log, for troubleshooting.
